# Transporeon: External Shipment Status and Documents API (for third parties)

- **Product:** Transporeon: External Shipment Status and Documents API (for third parties) (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** Bearer token. Declared security schemes: bearerAuth.
- **Access:** Third parties integrated with Transporeon Visibility.
- **To call it you would need:** a Transporeon Visibility (Sixfold) bearer token.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.sixfold.com/v1`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/sixfold-v1-documentation-ext-shipment-status-api-yaml](https://api.sixfold.com/v1/documentation/ext-shipment-status/api.yaml) (External Shipment Status and Documents API, version 1.2.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/467927047/External+Shipment+Update+API+for+third+parties.

## external-shipment-documents

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DELETE` | `/companies/{company_id}/transports/documents/{document_id}` | `reference` | Delete a document from a transport. | company_id* (path); document_id* (path); body: application/json |
| `POST` | `/companies/{company_id}/transports/documents` | `reference` | Create a document for a transport by transport ID, transport number, or custom ID | company_id* (path); body: application/json |

## external-shipment-update

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/companies/{company_id}/external-shipment-status-update` | `reference` | Create or update existing shipment status by Shipper assigned transport number or Platform assigned transport number of shipment | company_id* (path); body: application/json |

`*` marks a required parameter.
